scope: Evaluate a charge record in the same finite-width preparation as PR 335 for all permitted contributions of the published one-edge N15 family. Establish whether an unconditional physical P3 distribution is identified. No new physical signal or calibration is assumed.
common_bins: (-inf,-1),[-1,-1/4),[-1/4,0),{0},(0,1/4),[1/4,1),[1,inf). Fixed bare source units for every mass. Distinct orthogonal records are an added diagnostic instrument. Check all bins summed and alternatives with no register.
preparation: Same seven relative-clock boxes, 1% density windows, dT/3 and dw/2, hard original 0<w<1 domain, common exterior clock lobes superposed, not averaged in probability. Integrate overlaps with the physical field domain for partial boxes; no selection by sign. True and matched empty vacuum considered separately.
weights: Reconstruct both published positive four-mark column witnesses. Split each column uniformly over its distinct fine four-mark orbits, independently of charge. Keep every qualified type of that one-edge family. The two witnesses are not bounds on all weights. Affine mixes use the coherent amplitudes.
readout: Project scalar to the inherited regulated three-mode channel with common centered Gaussian input, use its full output Hilbert product summing all cross-type overlaps. Include gravity phase exp(i F4), dust phase including boundary densities, and the integration Jacobians. Normalize only after summing weighted branch amplitudes. Report record probabilities, interference and dephased type control, numerical stability and limitations.
numerics: Scrambled Sobol integration at nested powers of two, independent fixed scrambles. Use convergence table. Comparisons are numerical, not rigorous P3 uncertainty. No public preregistration.
